proposal.proposal_markdown:
## Project Overview

Supply Yard LLC has asked for a reinforced masonry security wall around its supply yard: 400 linear feet long and 8 feet high, built from standard 8x8x16 concrete masonry units with #5 vertical rebar every 32 inches, solid grout in every reinforced cell, and a smooth concrete cap. The wall is delivered with two coats of exterior paint and a decorative stucco finish on the street side.

## Scope of Work & Materials

| Material | Quantity | Unit | Unit Cost | Line Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8x8x16 concrete masonry units (CMU) | 3600 | each | $3.20 | $11,520.00 |
| #5 rebar, vertical every 32 inches | 1200 | linear_ft | $1.10 | $1,320.00 |
| solid grout fill for reinforced cells | 13 | cu_yd | $190.00 | $2,470.00 |
| smooth concrete cap | 400 | linear_ft | $14.00 | $5,600.00 |
| mortar | 3200 | sq_ft | $0.55 | $1,760.00 |

## Project Investment

- Materials: $22,670.00
- Labor: $13,602.00
- Overhead: $5,440.80
- Contingency: $3,627.20
- **Final Bid Price: $45,340.00**

## Assumptions & Exclusions

- Permit fees and inspection fees are excluded.
- Subsurface rock excavation and unsuitable soil removal are excluded.
- Footing design by a licensed engineer is excluded and assumed to be provided by the owner.

## Validity & Acceptance

This bid is valid for 30 days from the date of issue. Acceptance of this proposal authorizes the work described above.
